# <Product / Feature>: PRD

## Problem

Who has the problem and what it is. The cost of leaving it unsolved.

## Goals

What success looks like. Outcomes, not features.

## Non-goals

Explicitly out of scope, so nothing is assumed in.

## Users

Who uses this and the job they are doing.

## Design direction

The overall look and the design-system source. <Brand, the feel, the Figma file it draws
on.> Per-feature detail lives in each feature spec's design brief.

## Scope (this version)

The feature list, each with a "done when" acceptance line.

| # | Feature | Done when |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 |  |  |

## Acceptance

The conditions the whole thing is accepted on, written so they can become tests.

## Open questions

Decisions not yet made, and who owns each.
